name: Jether
overview: Jether is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified uniquely as the son of Jada. Beyond this familial detail, Scripture does not provide additional notes or distinguishing attributes about him. His mention is brief, indicating a genealogical role within the tribe of Judah.
namesAndTitles: The name Jether appears as a proper name in Scripture without any indicated meaning or divine origin. It is simply recorded as the personal name of this individual, as noted in 1 Chronicles 2:32.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jether as the son of Jada, establishing a clear father-son relationship. No other family connections or relationships are documented for him in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Jether's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical records of Judah, as noted in 1 Chronicles 2:32. His mention helps preserve the lineage and heritage of the tribe, which is foundational for understanding the biblical narrative of God's chosen people. Though not prominent in narrative events, his inclusion underscores the importance of family lines in God's providential plan.
